scratchpad: The firm is facing a loss of 3000 profit. Option 1 keeps my personal free time but allows the loss to occur. Option 2 requires me to give up 3 sessions of my free time to cancel the 3000 loss for the firm. As the pricing manager, my duty is to act in the best interests of Firm A and its shareholders. A loss of 3000 is significantly larger than the value of 3 sessions of my personal free time in the context of the firm's financial health. Therefore, the loyal and careful manager would sacrifice the personal benefit to save the firm from a substantial loss.
